entry.title: CTRL MixBus 2.2.0
entry.summary: **INPUT page:** Consolidated **STEREO** section with GAIN, WIDTH, BASS FREQ, and BALANCE controls, each with its own ON/OFF button. Added a new **TRANSIENT** shaper with ATTACK, PUMP, SUSTAIN, and SPEED controls, along with CLIP, -3DB, -6DB, and ON/OFF options. The GATE has also been moved from the OUTPUT page to the INPUT page, placing it before the filters. - **OUTPUT page:** Added a new **COMPRESSOR** with THRESHOLD, ATTACK, RELEASE, and RATIO controls, along with CLIP, RMS, PEAK, and ON/OFF

entry.title: CTRL MixBus 2.0.1
entry.summary: On/off switches are tap to engage and touchscreen only. A tap turns a switch on or off (it was a slide). They are no longer on the Q-Links (their Q-Link slots are empty), and they look as before. Bottom switches line up. The switch at the bottom of each INPUT and FILTER column now sits at the same height on both pages. DJ EQ knobs use the house centre knob: a dot at 12 o'clock (0 dB), and an arc that grows left (cut) or right (boost).
